adaptations_and_unspecified_details: Pi0.5 full-parameter fine-tuning: flow matching, one frame, horizon50, 7 physical controls padded to32. User-selected v4 loss supervises only0:7 and masks7:32. VLM is fully trainable; existing converted base is reused.
Linear action-token conditioning remains an explicit conditional-policy adapter; baseline has no action conditioning. Author source uses nonlinear prompt projection and feature concatenation.

AE hidden/latent dimensions, two-view concatenation, kappa=4 and held-out-ID calibration are explicit reproduction choices, not claimed author hyperparameters. Fifty rollout episodes and task horizons follow the referenced Robomimic benchmark; REACH does not restate exact evaluation counts.

AE optimization correction: Adam at lr=1e-4 replaces the original SGD lr=1e-4 after fixed-sample and full-data diagnostics found negligible SGD updates. This is an explicit optimizer deviation from the SGD reproduction setting, not a change to policy optimization. Original detector logs/checkpoints are archived.
Original masks are used when present; Paired initial-scene grouping is enforced for both masks and fallback splits.
All demonstrations are retained for Paired policy and AE_Paired; no success-label supervision is introduced.
Three runs use seeds 0/1/2; exact author seeds are not specified.
Datasets use robosuite v1.4.1 to match the local environment; this does not guarantee original-paper numerical reproduction.

Full-SFT v3 uses OpenPI AdamW defaults and a 1000-step warmup with cosine decay compressed to the configured Can training duration; float32 parameter training and configurable gradient accumulation are supported OpenPI choices. Epoch50/global64 remain task experiment choices, not universal Pi0.5 hyperparameters.

Historical frozen-VLM v2 outputs remain under outputs/paper_can; v3 full32 inspection artifacts remain in outputs/pi05_full_sft_v3; new v4 jobs default to outputs/pi05_full_sft_physical7_v4 and cannot resume legacy optimizer/statistics.

User batch choice: 8 GPUs * micro8 * accumulation1 = global64. On Paired this gives277 optimizer updates/epoch and13850 updates in50 epochs; cosine duration follows the computed update count. The later v4 request adds a dimension mask only; no timestep mask.

User-requested v4 objective: only physical action channels0:7 are supervised, rather than official full32 loss. Model tensors remain32D and VLM remains fully trainable. Validation and best-checkpoint selection use the same physical7 loss. No timestep mask added. Fresh output root outputs/pi05_full_sft_physical7_v4.

Current conditional prompt mixture follows the published main conditional source:45% zero Base and55% own GT; no shuffle. Historical30/30/40 shuffle runs and checkpoints retain their recorded args. This change does not identify the final paper Can config.
